## Features

What the system does. Each feature is proven at the levels it requires.

| Feature | What it does | `conformance` | `concurrency` | `versioning` | `faults` | `compatibility` | `security` | `operations` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vc.status` | dolt.status lists staged and unstaged changes. | — | — | ⬜ | — | — | — | — |
| `vc.add` | dolt_add() stages tables. | — | — | ⬜ | — | — | — | — |
| `vc.commit` | dolt_commit() records a commit, with -m, -a, --allow-empty and --author. | — | — | ⬜ | ⬜ | — | — | — |

| `vc.rm` | dolt_rm() removes tables from the working set and staging. | — | — | ⬜ | — | — | — | — |
| `vc.stash` | dolt_stash() pushes, pops, drops and lists stashes. | — | — | ⬜ | — | — | — | — |
| `vc.ignore` | dolt_ignore keeps matching tables out of commits. | — | — | ⬜ | — | — | — | — |
| `vc.tag` | dolt_tag() creates, deletes and lists tags. | — | — | ⬜ | — | — | — | — |

| `vc.branch.delete` | dolt_branch('-d') deletes a branch, and -D forces it. | — | — | ⬜ | ⬜ | — | — | — |
| `vc.checkout` | dolt_checkout() switches branch, creates one with -b, or restores a table. | — | — | ⬜ | — | — | — | — |

## Invariants

What the system must never do, or must always do, for each subject it applies to.

### `database` invariants

Where a row names several levels, each cell shows one mark per level, in that order.

| Invariant | Family | Levels | `doltgres.main` | `doltgres.release` | `postgres.reference` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`vc.branch_isolated`](#inv-vc.branch_isolated) | versioning | `versioning`, `concurrency` | ⬜ ⬜ | ⬜ ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.branch_ops_atomic`](#inv-vc.branch_ops_atomic) | versioning | `versioning`, `faults` | ⬜ ⬜ | ⬜ ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.commit_atomic`](#inv-vc.commit_atomic) | versioning | `versioning`, `concurrency` | ⬜ ⬜ | ⬜ ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.diff_complete`](#inv-vc.diff_complete) | versioning | `versioning` | ⬜ | ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.history_immutable`](#inv-vc.history_immutable) | versioning | `versioning`, `faults` | ⬜ ⬜ | ⬜ ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.merge_constraints`](#inv-vc.merge_constraints) | versioning | `versioning` | ⬜ | ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.merge_no_silent_loss`](#inv-vc.merge_no_silent_loss) | versioning | `versioning` | ⬜ | ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.push_atomic`](#inv-vc.push_atomic) | sharing | `faults` | ⬜ | ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.remote_equal`](#inv-vc.remote_equal) | sharing | `versioning`, `faults` | ⬜ ⬜ | ⬜ ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.reset_restores`](#inv-vc.reset_restores) | versioning | `versioning` | ⬜ | ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.revert_inverse`](#inv-vc.revert_inverse) | versioning | `versioning` | ⬜ | ⬜ | — |
| [`vc.schema_scoped`](#inv-vc.schema_scoped) | versioning | `versioning` | ⬜ | ⬜ | — |

- <a id="inv-vc.branch_isolated"></a>**`vc.branch_isolated`** · versioning — Writes on one branch are invisible on another until merged, across sessions.
- <a id="inv-vc.branch_ops_atomic"></a>**`vc.branch_ops_atomic`** · versioning — A failed branch operation leaves no branch, tag or permission row behind.
- <a id="inv-vc.commit_atomic"></a>**`vc.commit_atomic`** · versioning — dolt_commit records exactly the committed state at that moment, never half of a concurrent transaction.
- <a id="inv-vc.diff_complete"></a>**`vc.diff_complete`** · versioning — A diff between two commits lists exactly the rows that differ between their snapshots.
- <a id="inv-vc.history_immutable"></a>**`vc.history_immutable`** · versioning — A commit's content never changes: AS OF a commit always returns the same rows.
- <a id="inv-vc.merge_constraints"></a>**`vc.merge_constraints`** · versioning — A merge result satisfies the constraints, or each violation is recorded and reported.
- <a id="inv-vc.merge_no_silent_loss"></a>**`vc.merge_no_silent_loss`** · versioning — A merge keeps both sides' changes, or reports a conflict or a violation. It never drops a change silently.
- <a id="inv-vc.push_atomic"></a>**`vc.push_atomic`** · sharing — A failed push leaves the remote at its old head.
- <a id="inv-vc.remote_equal"></a>**`vc.remote_equal`** · sharing — A clone, pull or fetch equals the source at that commit, row for row and by hash.
- <a id="inv-vc.reset_restores"></a>**`vc.reset_restores`** · versioning — reset --hard returns the working set exactly to HEAD.
- <a id="inv-vc.revert_inverse"></a>**`vc.revert_inverse`** · versioning — Reverting a commit restores what it changed, when nothing later conflicts.
- <a id="inv-vc.schema_scoped"></a>**`vc.schema_scoped`** · versioning — Version-control functions act on the named schema's table, not another schema's.
